item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Israel Strikes Hezbollah as Lebanon Impasse Threatens Cease-Fire
item.summary: Israel said it would continue striking the Iran-backed militia. Iran said it would not attend peace talks with the United States in Pakistan if the truce was not extended to Lebanon.

item.title: Iran’s Battered Leaders Emerge From War Confident — and With New Cards
item.summary: For Iran’s theocratic rulers, just surviving the U.S.-Israeli onslaught means victory. But the seeds of their next crisis may already be planted.

item.title: Lebanon: Images of a Nation Uprooted by War
item.summary: A million people in Lebanon have fled their homes as Israel clashes anew with Hezbollah. This is what their lives look now.

item.title: Vance Faces Test of His Negotiating Skills With Iran Talks
item.summary: Vice President JD Vance is leading negotiations this weekend toward an end to a war that he had opposed starting.

item.title: Middle East War Triggers Higher Prices in China
item.summary: Three and a half years of deflationary pressure on Chinese factories reversed course last month as higher energy prices cycled into the economy.

item.title: Soaring Fuel Prices Squeeze China’s Frugal Truckers
item.summary: Many long-haul truckers in China have a tight budget and live frugally on the road, sleeping and cooking in their vehicles. Now, the pain at the pump is forcing some drivers to rethink their lives.

item.title: With Iran Setting Limits, Strait of Hormuz Remains Thorny Politically
item.summary: Even after a cease-fire, Iran is keeping a chokehold on traffic, forcing countries to cut deals that could put them at odds with the U.S.

item.title: Zelensky Sees Small Window for Peace
item.summary: Talks to end the war in Ukraine could resume soon, said President Volodymyr Zelensky as he expressed skepticism about a breakthrough.

item.title: What to Know About the U.S.-Iran Cease-Fire
item.summary: The truce is under strain because of two issues, Lebanon and the Strait of Hormuz. U.S. and Iranian negotiators are scheduled to meet in Pakistan this weekend.

item.title: 3 Russian Submarines Detected Near Britain Were Spying, U.K. Says
item.summary: John Healey, the defense secretary, said the vessels were gathering information about undersea pipelines, and said he believed President Vladimir V. Putin “would want us to be distracted by the Middle East.”
